title: Role-Relevant Technical Skills
description: Demonstrates working knowledge of the technologies the role calls for. Strong answers go beyond surface-level definitions and show how the candidate has applied the skill in real work.

title: Coding Skills
description: Demonstrates clean, idiomatic, working code; understands data structures, complexity, and language idioms.

title: System Architecture
description: Designs sensible end-to-end systems with clear component boundaries, data flow, scaling, and trade-offs.

title: AI Awareness
description: Understands modern AI/ML concepts relevant to delivery: prompts, RAG, embeddings, evaluation, responsible-AI considerations.

title: Debugging & Troubleshooting Mindset
description: Forms hypotheses, isolates variables, uses logs/telemetry, and reasons through failure modes.

title: Logical Thinking & Learning Ability
description: Breaks problems down, reasons from first principles, picks up new concepts quickly during the conversation.

title: Communication & Clarity of Thought
description: Explains ideas crisply, structures answers, listens and adapts to questions.

title: Seeks Clarity Before Solutioning
description: Asks clarifying questions, validates assumptions, and confirms scope before jumping to a solution.

title: Ownership & Responsibility
description: Demonstrates accountability for outcomes, follow-through, and care for users/team.
